project.name: Bytecode transformer: Java run-time checks in students' code
project.description: Rewrites class files so that they perform the checks the Java language requires and TeaVM's JavaScript and WebAssembly output omits: array index (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException "Index i out of bounds for length n"), integer division and remainder by zero (ArithmeticException "/ by zero"), negative array size. Run on the course programs before TeaVM (web-bridge) and built into the in-browser compiler (tools/browser-javac/build.sh).
